description: The FTC has taken enforcement actions (e.g., FTC v. Rite Aid) indicating that companies cannot shift blame for AI failures to their vendors.

instances.assertion: The FTC has taken enforcement actions (e.g., FTC v. Rite Aid) indicating that companies cannot shift blame for AI failures to their vendors.
Large companies, such as Rite Aid, have been held liable for AI-related issues and cannot easily shift blame to their AI vendors.
